summary.whatChanges: When `fakeTimers.toNotFake` is set (and `toFake` is not), Vitest now always appends `nextTick` and `queueMicrotask` to the exclusion list, so those APIs stay native. Docs are reworded and unit tests updated accordingly.
behaviorChanges: With `toNotFake` configured, `process.nextTick` is no longer replaced by fake timers, on any pool (not just forks)
With `toNotFake` configured, `queueMicrotask` is no longer replaced by fake timers
Other timers listed outside `toNotFake` (e.g. setTimeout) continue to be faked as before
Docs now state that faking nextTick/queueMicrotask requires using `toFake`
risks: Tests that relied on nextTick or queueMicrotask being faked while using `toNotFake` will now hang or behave differently until switched to `toFake`
Silent config override: users explicitly omitting these from `toNotFake` get them excluded anyway, with no warning
